Latin word

eāmus

eāmus, videāmus

the present subjunctive, first person plural, in -āmus (-ēmus in the first conjugation); negative nē

let’s go, let’s see

In this lexicon

  • let’s

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Eun. 459: Eāmus ergō ad cēnam; Hor. S. 1.1.27: āmōtō quaerāmus sēria lūdō

Examples

  • Eāmus ergō ad cēnam: quid stās?

    Let’s go to dinner, then: why are you standing there?Ter. Eun. 459
